lines.en: I cannot move, only sway with the wind
I hang beneath the leaf, swinging

lines.zh: 风把我推了一下，我就晃
lines.en: The wind nudges me and I rock
I have no feet, I cannot walk

lines.zh: 枝条一弯，我跟着低下去
lines.en: The branch bends and I dip with it
The wind shifted me half a finger's width

lines.zh: 我一晃，里面的东西也在晃
lines.en: I sway, and what is inside sways too

lines.zh: 我这一路只是被风带着
lines.en: My only travel is what the wind gives me
The shade under the leaf turns with me
My silk is still holding

lines.zh: 风吹过我的壳，声音很闷
lines.en: Wind crosses my shell with a muffled sound

lines.zh: 我在枝上不动，风在替我动
lines.en: I stay put on the branch, the wind moves for me
I can only wait for the wind to stop
My shell rises and falls with the branch
The hanging makes it sway the most

lines.zh: 我挂的高度刚好避开叶面
lines.en: I hang just clear of the leaf

lines.zh: 我挂在叶背，什么都不做
lines.en: I hang on the underside, doing nothing
It is dark and cramped inside

lines.zh: 外面有太阳，我感觉得到
lines.en: I can feel the sun outside

lines.zh: 我在慢慢变成另一个样子
lines.en: I am slowly becoming something else
Not a breath of wind, very still

lines.zh: 我的壳硬了，颜色也变了
lines.en: My shell has hardened and changed color
I have lost count of the days
Something crawled past me
I wait for movement inside
This step cannot be hurried

lines.zh: 我的旧皮还挂在壳边上
lines.en: My old skin still clings to the shell

lines.zh: 我什么都听，什么都做不了
lines.en: I hear everything, and can do nothing
You saw me, hanging here

lines.zh: 我动不了，你也不该动我
lines.en: I cannot move, and you should not move me
Your face is very close
I am hanging under the leaf; do not pick me off.
I am changing, do not interrupt

lines.zh: 你伸手的时候，我壳里紧了一下
lines.en: When you reached out, I tightened inside
I am only a shell right now

lines.zh: 等一阵子，我就不在这里了
lines.en: In a while, I will not be here
You looked up and happened to see me
My silk still ties me to the leaf
The knock set me swinging
A thin crack opens in my hard shell.
It hurts, and I cannot cry out
Something clenched inside
I only slowly stop swaying
That was heavy
My silk has loosened
I am still on the branch, I did not fall
That has hurried my timing
I will remember that jolt

lines.zh: 我这层壳，什么都进不来。
lines.en: Nothing gets through this shell of mine.
Bringing a leaf does nothing

lines.zh: 我不需要，我在里面等着
lines.en: I need nothing, I wait inside
This shell neither eats nor drinks
Set it beside me
I do not even have a mouth now

lines.zh: 再过些天，我会自己去找
lines.en: In some days I will go find my own

lines.zh: 你拿给我的，是给外面那个的
lines.en: What you bring is for the one who comes out
I smell it, and I do not move
Keep that mouthful for yourself.

lines.zh: 你碰到我了，我晃得厉害
lines.en: You touched me and I swung hard
I hang by silk and nearly fell
My shell is brittle, do not press
One touch and something stirred inside
I cannot retreat, I can only bear it

lines.zh: 你手指的温度传进来了
lines.en: The warmth of your finger came through
That loosened the silk a little
I stop swaying only once I steady
You stand below and watch
Push again and I fall

lines.zh: 我现在这个样子谈不了
lines.en: In this shape, it is out of the question
There are other chrysalises around
We hang from the same branch
Each of us waits inside
Neither of us touches the other
Talk to me after I have emerged.
Silk against silk counts as close
This waiting is the same for both

lines.zh: 我们一起挨过这段日子
lines.en: We endure this stretch together
The wind comes and we sway as one
I cannot move, so you take me

lines.zh: 我连着叶子一起被扯下来
lines.en: I am pulled off together with the leaf
Off the branch, I am lost
Do not squeeze, it would spoil inside
My silk is broken
Put me back in the shade
Your fingerprint is on my shell
Too hot, it is too hot here
I hear the wind outside
Hang me back, please
Something is nearing this branch

lines.zh: 叶子一颤，我就知道有东西来了。
lines.en: When the leaf trembles, I know something is coming.
I cannot move, only wait
Someone touched the leaf
That step was close, right beside me
My shell is tightening
The movement inside is faster

lines.zh: 我要么现在出来，要么完了
lines.en: I either come out now or it ends
A shadow moved outside
I have only one way
The shaking is strong
The silk is about to break
I hear breathing very near
Something is touching my shell
There is not much time
The inside is moving now
I cannot hold much longer

lines.zh: 再这样下去，我会提前出来
lines.en: At this rate, I will come out early
I cannot see, and I still know
I wait for this to pass
The shell hardened — all I can do is wait.
I swung and struck you
The shell is hard, a knock hurts
A thin crack opened in me

lines.zh: 这一下不是攻击，是被撞
lines.en: That was not an attack, only being hit
I struggle inside the shell
My silk tangled once
I have no teeth and no claws
That made me more urgent
I must come out soon

lines.zh: 我在叶背上结成这个样子
lines.en: I formed this shape on the leaf's underside

lines.zh: 我挂了好些天，颜色发旧
lines.en: I've hung for days and my colours have dulled
My place is beside the vein
I crawled here one last time

lines.zh: 外面的一切都隔着一层壳
lines.en: Everything outside is one shell away
My shed skin lies beside me
I am hanging firmer than I expected

lines.zh: 周围是绿的，我却是别的颜色
lines.en: All is green around me, and I am another color
I slowly go quiet

lines.zh: 下一样东西会从这壳里出来
lines.en: Something else will come out of this shell
Fire nears and my shell grows hot

lines.zh: 我从枝上掉下去，壳裂了
lines.en: I drop from the branch and my shell cracks
Water seeps in, and the inside soaks
The shock loosened me from the silk

lines.zh: 飞来的东西打穿了我的壳
lines.en: Something flying punched through my shell
That force slipped into the shell
I grow emptier inside
Lightning shines through my shell
No leaf to hang from in the void
